BiblicalUsage: Kenath means a colleague, a companion, one who shares the same title: Ezra 4:9 lists Rehum and Shimshai and the rest of their companions, the nations settled in Samaria. Ezra 4:17 has the king answering Rehum and the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria. Ezra 4:23 says the companions went up in haste to Jerusalem and made the Jews cease by force and power. Ezra 5:3 has Tatnai and Shethar-boznai and their companions asking who commanded the building.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe companionship cuts both ways: these companions joined to stop God's house, and the builders' companions joined to raise it. I hold that the company you keep decides the wall you build.
